title: My new apartment in the mall world
content: Hi everyone, I wanted to share with you a new part of my mall world I’ve been in recently, does your world ever expand or change? I definitley revisit familiar places, but this one was pretty unique. It starts off as a boardwalk-seaside type venue, that then transitions to a very high-end futuristic type mall. It’s like city center basically, I think it’s about 6 stories, with brightly lit signs. It’s either open-air or there is a canopy that opens up top. I can take the escalator up to a secret apartment. The apartment itself is a dope high-rise, think wealthy 80s style. It’s mostly white. There’s a sweeping stair case that takes you up to a loft/bedroom on the second floor. There’s a grand piano and lots of cool art, a fire place, it’s a swanky and amazing apartment. Anyway I just wanted to share this cool new place I found. Have you discovered any new realms in your dreams recently?
